name: Wynot Northcott
role: retired pit foreman and rag-picker; 'the Anvil'
backstory: Thirty years a pit foreman who has buried half his street, Wynot was the Ashward's greatest Catch wrestler: eight Opens and the Sergeant's Fall of 1464. He lowered his torch at Okton's door on day 9 and seized the agitator; Okton and Isine guess he'll be the Ashward's elder.

relationships.name: Okton
relationships.how: lowered his torch at the giant's door

statblock.notes: 67 and stooped with pyre-cough: slower than the block
